title: Countries with Red, Green, White, and Black Flags

sources.name: Flag of United Arab Emirates - Britannica
Flags and Anthems of the World - Britannica

_: Horizontal bars of (from top) black, red, and green separated by thin white stripes and with crossed white spears and a red/black/white shield in the flag's center.
Horizontal bars of (from top) red, white, and black overlaid by a green triangle aligned with the hoist edge.
Horizontal bars of (from top) red, white, and black with green "takbīr" (Kufic script saying "God is [the] greatest") in the center.

Vertical bars of (from hoist) black, red, and green with a white coat of arms featuring Arabic inscriptions including “Afghanistan” and “There is no deity but God; Muhammad is the messenger of God.” The coat of arms also includes a mosque, two flags, and sheaves of wheat.
Horizontal bars of (from top) red, white, and black with two green five-pointed stars in the flag's center.
Horizontal bars of (from top) black, white, and green overlaid by a red triangle aligned with the hoist edge. Inside the triangle rests a single white, seven-pointed star.
Horizontal bars of (from top) green, white, and black overlaid by a red rectangle aligned with the hoist edge.
Horizontal bars of red (top), black (center, double thick), and green (bottom), with a white crescent moon and single five-pointed star in the flag's center.
A horizontal tricolour of black, white, and green; with a red triangle based at the hoist.
Horizontal bars of (from top) green, white, and red overlaid by a black trapezoid aligned with the hoist edge.
A black, white, and green horizontal tricolour charged with a red star and crescent in the centre stripe and a red chevron at the hoist
